moments.title: Born in Las Vegas
moments.summary: Ronald Joseph Aaron Radke is born in Las Vegas, Nevada.

moments.title: Growing up in Las Vegas
moments.summary: Childhood in the Vegas valley; family life with brothers Anthony and Matthew.

moments.title: Mid‑90s adolescence
moments.summary: Teen years in Vegas; hip‑hop, punk, and metal start shaping his taste.

moments.title: Discovering post‑hardcore
moments.summary: Deepens into screamo and punk — the lane that later defines ETF and FIR.

moments.title: High school years
moments.summary: Las Vegas high school era; writing lyrics and chasing a frontman role.

moments.title: First local shows
moments.summary: Playing Vegas house shows and small venues with early projects.

moments.title: Auditions & early lineup
moments.summary: Searching for the right drummer and guitarists before ETF solidifies.

moments.title: Vegas post‑hardcore scene

moments.title: There's No Sympathy for the Dead EP (2005)

moments.title: Dying Is Your Latest Fashion
moments.summary: Escape the Fate releases debut album on Epitaph; Radke's emo-screamo look defines the era.

moments.title: 2006 Las Vegas altercation
moments.summary: Altercation leads to charges related to brass knuckles; friend fatally shoots Michael Cook in self-defense. Radke receives probation.

moments.title: ETF touring cycle
moments.summary: Debut album touring; Radke's look and voice become scene‑defining.

moments.title: Falling in Reverse begins
moments.summary: FIR forms while Radke is incarcerated; lineup and demos set up the comeback.

moments.title: Departure from Escape the Fate
moments.summary: Radke is removed from ETF amid legal fallout; Craig Mabbitt replaces him.

moments.title: Probation violation & prison
moments.summary: Fails to report to probation officer; arrested and sentenced to prison (released 2010).

moments.title: Writing FIR material inside
moments.summary: Demoing and planning Falling in Reverse while serving time.

moments.title: Radke–Mabbitt feud during prison
moments.summary: While Radke was in prison, tension with Mabbitt escalated through live shows and social media, including a notorious Warped Tour heckle exchange.

moments.title: Released from prison
moments.summary: Radke is released; begins recording and touring with Falling in Reverse.

moments.title: The Drug in Me Is You
moments.summary: FIR debut album lands; singles push Radke back into mainstream rock visibility.

moments.title: The Drug in Me Is You — rollout

moments.title: Solo single “Fair-Weather Fans” & YouTube channel
moments.summary: On May 31, 2013, Radke launched his YouTube channel and released the solo song "Fair-Weather Fans," described as a message to people who did not believe in him. He followed with "What Up Earth?" the next day.

moments.title: Rap mixtape plans (Alternative Press)
moments.summary: In an Alternative Press interview, Radke said he was working on a free rap mixtape produced by Charles Massabo (Kallaghan Records), planned for December 2013, with guest features from established rap artists.

moments.title: Daughter & engagement with Crissy Henderson
moments.summary: Radke has a daughter from his relationship with model Crissy Henderson. He was engaged to Henderson at one point; the couple later separated.

moments.title: Death of brother Anthony (2013)
moments.summary: Radke's older brother Anthony died in a traffic collision in 2013.

moments.title: Diss track “I Wash Cars” (Sumerian feud)
moments.summary: A diss track titled "I Wash Cars" leaked online, targeting Sumerian Records, founder Ash Avildsen, Lorenzo "The Main Event" Antonucci, and I See Stars. Avildsen and Antonucci replied with "When Ronnie Met Sally." The feud was later resolved and Radke said the two sides were on good terms again.

moments.summary: FIR and Escape the Fate co‑headline — public feud cools on stage.

moments.title: 2014 incident
